method: Complete candidate survey followed by individual editorial choices and written reasons, applied to the existing complete guide to keep it within 300 quotations. All verified authorized selections included. Priority given to foundational teachings, substantive explanations, necessary qualifications, distinctive applications, narrative examples and thematic breadth across the tension of justice and mercy, honest confession and remorse, images of ocean, light, shelter and healing, forgiveness and a changed life, prayer for the community and for opponents, intercession for parents, children and companions, prayer for the departed, answered requests, and closing humility and hope. Neither citation count nor source order used as a ranking rule. The existing reading arc is retained.

selected.text: O Lord! Forgive Thy servant Hussein and perfume his nostrils with the fragrance of Thy pardon. Verily Thou art the Generous, the Merciful, the Exalted.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that a servant’s nostrils be perfumed with the fragrance of pardon; distinctive image.

selected.text: O Lord! Send down from the heaven of Thy mercy that which will set right my affairs, then enable me to make good what hath escaped me during the dawning of the lights of the Day-Star of Thy Revelation.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking to make good what has escaped one during the dawning of the Revelation; repair after failure.

selected.text: and rushed from this world to Thy world. They traversed Thy path, sought Thy good-pleasure, and spoke Thy mystery. O Lord! Make Khusraw Rustam intimate with Thy forgiveness, grant Makhmal Bahram repose beneath Thy protection, and make Sarv Salamat a manifestation of Thy forgiveness. Thou art the Forgiver, the Bestower, and the Kind One
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá naming three souls who passed and asking that they be intimate with forgiveness; named intercession.

selected.text: I beseech God to forgive you and pardon us and you, to clothe you in the robes of bounty, to cause you to enter the Garden of Meeting, and grant you the vision of the Beauty in the mornings and evenings.
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá praying forgiveness for the recipient and for us; mutual intercession.

selected.text: the Kind Lord: O Lord, forgive Your hopeful servant of yesterday and bestow upon her triumph, success, pardon and forgiveness. Immerse her in the ocean of Your bounty and cleanse and sanctify her from the dross of sin
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that a servant be cleansed and sanctified from the dross of sin; purification as part of pardon.

selected.text: O Lord! The mountain of rebellion hath turned toward the ocean of Thy forgiveness. I beseech Thee by Thy mercy which hath preceded all created things to blot out his misdeeds through Thy bounty and grace.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh: the mountain of rebellion hath turned toward the ocean of forgiveness; a striking image of return.

selected.text: O Thou Almighty! O Thou Forgiving Lord! Endear Thou this believing, assured maidservant of God in Thy Kingdom and submerge her in the ocean of Thy Grace and illumine her countenance in Thy Kingdom, El Abha.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that a maidservant be submerged in the ocean of grace in the Kingdom; prayer for the departed.

selected.text: O Thou kind Lord! My shortcomings are many and my righteous deeds are none. I am a sinner, an evil-doer … O my God! Grant Thy grace, bestow Thy favor, show Thy generosity, and deal with me through Thy mercy
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá confessing many shortcomings and no righteous deeds and asking to be dealt with through mercy; plain admission of fault.

selected.text: O Lord! Though I am a sinner, I place my hopes in Thy forgiveness. I am destitute and poor; Thou art the Generous, the Succourer. I am afflicted and lowly; Thou art the Healer of every sick and captive soul.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá naming God the Healer of every sick and captive soul while placing hope in forgiveness; introduces the healing image.

selected.text: Seize them through Thy wrath, Thy might and Thy power, or aid them to return unto Thee and to repent before the gate of Thy pardon and Thy bounty. Verily Thou art the Generous, the Possessor of great bounty.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking that opponents be seized or aided to repent; retains the source’s distinction between justice and return.

selected.text: O Lord! O Creator! We are sinners and You are the Forgiver, we are guilty and You are the Magnanimous One. Though our transgressions are like a boundless ocean, Your pardon and forgiveness are greater still.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá declaring that transgressions like a boundless ocean are exceeded by pardon; a memorable image of scale.

selected.text: O Lord! O Forgiver! Bring Thy dear maidservant Mrs. Emily Noblack from the earthly world into the pure realm. Forgive sins, pardon faults, look not upon shortcomings, but deal according to Thy grace and bounty
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a named maidservant passing into the pure realm, asking that sins be forgiven and shortcomings overlooked; breadth of intercession.

selected.text: O my God! I testify that I denied You when You called me to faith, and rejected Your proof when You commanded me to acknowledge it. I beseech You by Your mercy to forgive me and join me with Your near servants.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh testifying to having denied God’s call and asking to be joined with the near servants; confession after rejection.

selected.text: As to thy request for forgiveness for thy departed father and others, it hath been granted. God hath forgiven them as a mercy and favor from His presence. He is verily the Forgiver, the Bountiful, the Generous.
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh granting a request for forgiveness for a departed father and others; answered prayer.

selected.text: O Lord! I cover My face in the dust of submission to Thy celestial Glory, beseeching Thee to forgive and pardon her father and to shelter him beneath the canopy of Thine abounding grace within Thy garden of repose.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that a father be sheltered beneath abounding grace; prayer for a parent.

selected.text: O Lord! Cover the sins, grant forgiveness, be the Concealer, be the Pardoner, and make her pure and sanctified from every sin. Thou art the Forgiver of sins and the Resplendent One from the dawning-place of pardon.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that a soul be made pure and sanctified from every sin; cleansing.

selected.text: Supplications were offered to the Abha Kingdom, and forgiveness and pardon were beseeched for Mulla Muhammad Rafi', and likewise for the handmaid of God Zakiyyih, entreaty for divine forgiveness and grace was made.
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá recording forgiveness sought for a man and a woman by name; intercession.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, therefore, by Thyself and by Them, to send down, from the right hand of the throne of Thy grace, upon all that dwell on earth, that which shall wash them from the stain of their trespasses against Thee
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: 'Abdu'l-Baha, with the utmost supplication and entreaty, sought pardon and forgiveness for him and besought grace and beneficence. It is certain that this prayer was answered at the threshold of the Most Glorious Beauty.
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá stating that his prayer for pardon was certainly answered; assurance to the bereaved.

selected.text: My God, my God! Prevent not Thy servants from the ocean of Thy bounty. If Thou forgivest them, this is of the wonders of Thy grace and bestowal; and if Thou chastiseth them, verily Thou art the Mighty, the Powerful.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh affirming that forgiveness is a wonder of grace and chastisement within divine power; a necessary qualification.

selected.text: God hath forgiven thy father and thy mother and thy kindred, and hath arrayed them in the robes of His loving-kindness as a bounty from His presence. Rejoice thou in this and say: Praise be unto Thee, O God of all worlds!
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh assuring that God has forgiven parents and kindred and bidding thanks; answered prayer.

selected.text: O Pure One! Make Kaykhusraw the sovereign of the realm of forgiveness and ordain him to be the king of the kingdom of bounty. Forgive his sins and deliver him from deprivation. Make him worthy of Thy favor and generosity.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that Kaykhusraw be made sovereign of the realm of forgiveness; distinctive image.

selected.text: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Take us not to task for what our hands have wrought, then forgive our sins, pardon us and have mercy upon us. Thou art verily the Lord of Bounty and Might, the Lord of Grace and Kingdom.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking not to be taken to task for what our hands have wrought; a communal petition for pardon.

selected.text: O my God, my God! Verily, Thy servant 'Ali-Muhammad standeth in need of pardon and forgiveness and assistance. I press my brow to the dust of Thy sacred Threshold and beseech forgiveness for him, O my Lord, the All-Merciful.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá pressing the brow to the dust to beseech forgiveness for a named servant; posture of intercession.

selected.text: O Kind Lord! Deliver Kheyrbam from the darkness of sins and grant eternal life in the realm of lights. Though we are immersed in transgression, we gaze toward the Kingdom of forgiveness. Carry out whatever befits Your mercy.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that a soul be delivered from the darkness of sins, confessing our own transgression; humility in intercession.

selected.text: Then I beseech You, O Forgiving One, to send down the layers of light from pardon and forgiveness upon the grave of the assured leaf who has returned to You … and to immerse his brother in the seas of mercy and forgiveness
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that layers of light descend on a grave and that a brother be immersed in mercy; family and departed.

selected.text: O Lord Who covers faults and bestows gifts, look not at transgressions - grant forgiveness. See not shortcomings, regard not lassitude. Thou art the All-Forgiving Lord. Verily Thou art the Generous, the Mighty, the Bestower.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to the Lord who covers faults, asking that transgressions and lassitude be overlooked; the image of covering.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou art forgiving and kind, and the Sovereign of the realm of pardon and forgiveness. These souls and this sinful servant beseech from the threshold of Thy grace and bounty pardon and forgiveness for these dear souls.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá in which a sinful servant joins others in seeking pardon for dear souls; humble intercession.

selected.text: Therefore, O God, forgive me and my parents and those who follow me in Thy judgment. Send down upon us Thy fragrances, honor us with Thy blessings, and protect us from all evil through the authority of Thine eternity
selected.reason: Prayer of the Báb asking forgiveness for self, parents and followers and protection from evil; a full family petition.

selected.text: I adjure Thee by Thy Name, the Concealer, to conceal whatsoever hath been wrought contrary to Thy good-pleasure, and by Thy Name, the All-Forgiving, to forgive us and to adorn Thy male and female servants with the robe of pardon.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh invoking the Names the Concealer and the All-Forgiving for male and female servants; distinctive use of divine names.

selected.text: Supplications and entreaties were made at the threshold of the Glorious Lord that He might immerse those two kind friends in the fountain of His Holiness Job and cleanse them from every fault and sin, rendering them pure and holy.
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá recording supplications that two friends be immersed in the fountain of Job and cleansed; distinctive allusion.

selected.text: Therefore the seeking of forgiveness by the loved ones and beseeching pardon and forgiveness from the Court of Unity on behalf of the deceased is legitimate and accepted and praiseworthy, and causes abundant pardon and progress
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá affirming that seeking forgiveness for the deceased is legitimate, praiseworthy and causes progress; foundation for prayer for the departed.

selected.text: My God, my God! I testify that Thy mercy hath preceded all created things and Thy grace hath encompassed all possibilities … I beseech Thee to assist me in all conditions to turn to Thee and to repent at the door of Thy generosity
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking for help to turn and repent at the door of generosity in all conditions; repentance as a continuing practice.

selected.text: This is Your servant who was set ablaze with the fire of Your love and was attracted by Your holy fragrances and responded to Your call and served at the threshold of Your mercy … seeking forgiveness for sins, relying upon Your pardon
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a servant who served at the threshold seeking forgiveness; service and pardon.

selected.text: Lo, O my God! I have raised the hands of hope toward the heaven of Thy mercy and forgiveness. I beseech Thee by the hands that were severed in Thy path that Thou wilt not send them back empty of what they seek from Thy grace and bounty.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh raising hands of hope toward mercy and asking not to be sent back empty; closing image of hope.

selected.text: O Lord! These pure souls have hastened toward Thee, quaffed from Thy plenteous stream, and desired to gaze upon Thy countenance. Immerse these thirsting ones in the ocean of Thy forgiveness, and rejoice and gladden them with Thy presence.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that pure souls be immersed in forgiveness and gladdened with God’s presence; hope for the departed.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou art the Pardoner, the Forgiver, and the All-Merciful. Thou dost not look upon faults, Thou art the Nurturer of bounty, Thou dost cover sins, grant refuge, and provide dwelling and shelter in the precincts of Thy great mercy.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá describing God as covering sins and providing dwelling and shelter in mercy; the shelter image.

selected.text: For Paridukht I have offered humble supplications at the threshold of God and sought forgiveness and pardon. And for Bahman-rad Rustam I opened my tongue in intercession and beseeched grace and forgiveness from the Most Glorious Kingdom.
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá recording intercession for two named people; prayer offered on request.

selected.text: Then forgive, O my God, him who was named Muhammad-'Ali, who attained unto Thy recognition and acknowledged what Thou didst command him in Thy Tablets, and ordain for him from the wonders of Thy favors what Thou lovest and art pleased with
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking forgiveness for a named believer who recognized God; personal intercession.

selected.text: O my God and my Master! I beseech You by this martyr who was martyred in Your path, and by this blood which was shed in Your love, that You forgive me and my parents and my relatives from among those who have believed in You and Your verses.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh invoking a martyr and his blood and asking forgiveness for self, parents and relatives; visitation prayer.

selected.text: to the treachery of certain covenant-breakers, were seen to be without effect or fruit. Therefore, no blame lies or has lain upon them. Say: My God, my God! Aid the treacherous to be trustworthy, the slanderers to be truthful, and the ungodly to return to the Tree of Thy oneness and the gate of Thy forgiveness and bounty. Verily, Thou art the Almighty, the All-Powerful
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh asking that the treacherous become trustworthy and slanderers truthful; links pardon to changed conduct.

selected.text: This is an insignificant handmaiden that hath sought refuge at the Door of Thy Oneness and is inclined to the Threshold of Thy Holiness. She seeketh mercy and the remission of her sins … Thou art the Ever-Forgiving and the Concealer of sins
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a handmaiden seeking refuge at the door of oneness and the remission of sins; a personal prayer of refuge.

selected.text: and (I beg of God) to make all mankind the children of His mercy! This is the utmost mercy of Abdul-Baha for which he is endeavoring night and day and is summoning all to this fountain which is flowing with the pure water of the gift of God.
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá beseeching God to make all mankind the children of His mercy; the widest circle of concern.

selected.text: the cause of our dishonor and their comfort the cause of our distress. Thus did the pure wine become turbid and the life-giving breeze turned into a violent tempest of inauspicious continuous days. Again, in consideration of your request, God willing, prostrate at the Sacred Threshold, supplication will be made seeking pardon and forgiveness
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá describing harm suffered yet promising supplication for pardon at the request of another; forgiveness alongside recognition of harm.

selected.text: And as for thy request for forgiveness for those souls thou didst mention - all have been adorned with the ornament of forgiveness and have attained unto the bounties of God. In this Night of Ridvan, the ocean of forgiveness hath embraced all.
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh answering a request: in this Night of Ridván the ocean of forgiveness hath embraced all; a key assurance.

selected.text: Then forgive me, O my God, and my father and mother, and those who are related to me. Then send down upon me of every good thing Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen servants. Then assign me a seat of truth in the vicinity of Thy greatest mercy.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking forgiveness for self, father, mother and relatives and a seat of truth near mercy; family pardon.

selected.text: Our errors are many, but Your ocean of mercy is boundless. Our weakness is great, but Your confirmation and success are manifest. Therefore, grant confirmation and bestow success, and make us successful in that which is worthy of Your threshold.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá contrasting many errors with a boundless ocean of mercy and asking for success in what befits the threshold; pardon leading to action.

selected.text: Abdu'l-Baha, in utmost humility and self-effacement, implores and supplicates at the Most Exalted Threshold that the illumined leaf, the content handmaiden of God, may become in the infinite Kingdom the manifestation of pardon and forgiveness
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá imploring in humility that a leaf become a manifestation of pardon in the Kingdom; hope for the departed.

selected.text: In any case, we seek forgiveness through goodly character and praiseworthy deeds - how much more so without them! Never have the deeds of a servant been worthy of the court of the Lord, unless His grace should take hold and His favor should assist.
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh stating that forgiveness is sought through goodly character and deeds, yet no deed is worthy without grace; a necessary qualification.

selected.text: O Thou Kind One! Cover Thou and conceal our faults. From Thee is bounty, from us transgression. From Thee faithfulness, from us sin. From Thee shelter, from us illness. From Thee healing. Cover and forgive, be faithful, give shelter, and bestow healing.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá contrasting bounty, faithfulness, shelter and healing from God with transgression and sin from us; a memorable antithesis.

selected.text: Do Thou graciously forgive me for the things that I have wrought in Thy holy presence, and look not upon me with the glance of justice, but rather deliver me through Thy grace, treat me with Thy mercy and deal with me according to Thy bountiful favours
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O divine Providence! Do not seize us in our sins, but give us refuge. Do not look upon our evil ways, but grant forgiveness. Consider not our just deserts, but open wide Thy door of grace. … Thou art the Mighty, the Powerful! Thou art the Seer, the Knower
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O Lord! Honor her resting place, grant her ultimate desire, shelter her in the vicinity of Thy mercy, make easy for her Thy gift, admit her to the garden of Thy grace, bring her to the stream of Thy divinity, and make her a sign of forgiveness and pardon.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that a departed woman be made a sign of forgiveness; hope for the departed.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the branches of the Tree of Thy singleness and Thy chosen ones who have been set ablaze with the fire of Thy love and have spent their substance and their spirits in Thy path, to forgive me and those who have believed in Thee and in Thy signs.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh invoking those who spent substance and spirit in His path to forgive believers; sacrifice and intercession.

selected.text: So he supplicated and implored Thee and came before Thee and beseeched Thee, submissive, humble, lowly, entreating, seeking forgiveness for sins, yearning to enter the world of the unseen, moved by the breezes of forgiveness, absolved from sin and transgression.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá describing a soul seeking forgiveness, yearning to enter the unseen world; preparation for death.

selected.text: O my Lord! Thou seest the sinner who seeketh the ocean of Thy forgiveness and pardon. I beseech Thee by Thy generosity which hath encompassed the world to forgive my misdeeds and transgressions, and to ordain for me that which will keep me steadfast in Thy Cause
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking forgiveness and that which will keep one steadfast in the Cause; links pardon with steadfastness.

selected.text: Forgiveness and pardon were sought from the Court of Unity for those souls who have ascended to the seat of truth, that they may be immersed in lights in the realm of mysteries and find rest under the protection of forgiveness through the favors of the Lord God.
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá recording forgiveness sought for souls who ascended, that they find rest under its protection; intercession for the departed.

selected.text: Therefore, O my God, forgive their sins and conceal their faults and save their souls and rescue their spirits and guide them to Thy manifest path and extended shade, and pardon and forgive them - they are weak captives. Verily, Thou art the Pardoner, the Forgiving.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that weak captives be forgiven and guided to the manifest path; compassion for those in error.

selected.text: This servant beseeches his Lord to spread another carpet and to purify the hearts of His servants with the waters of Kawthar and illumine them with the lights of His Most Great Countenance. Verily, He is the Hearing, the Answering, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh asking that hearts be purified with Kawthar and illumined with light; purification of hearts.

selected.text: O my God! I beseech Thee by the Most Great Word to ordain for me the word of forgiveness, for I intended in my soul what Thou didst not desire and what Thou forbade in Thy Book. I beseech Thee to remit my evil deeds and to immerse me in the ocean of Thy forgiveness
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh confessing an intention God forbade and asking to be immersed in the ocean of forgiveness; carries the guide’s prayer rejecting harm.

selected.text: My God! I beseech of Thee mercy and forgiveness for people who abandoned vain imaginings, purified themselves from disobedience, disassociated from the rebellious ones, and kept themselves free from all that is unworthy in the days of Thy manifestation among mankind.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá seeking mercy for those who abandoned vain imaginings and purified themselves; community renewal.

selected.text: O Thou Almighty! I am a sinner, but Thou art the Forgiver! I am full of shortcomings, but Thou art the Compassionate! I am in darkness of error, but Thou art the Light of Pardon! Therefore, O Thou Benevolent God, forgive my sins, grant Thy Bestowals, overlook my faults
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá calling God the Light of Pardon for one in the darkness of error; the light image in personal confession.

selected.text: O Divine Providence! O Thou Compassionate! Make Thou hopeful the servant that is covered with shame and cause him to perform good acts. Vouchsafe unto him Thy bountiful favours. Do not look at my trespasses and disregard my misdeeds. Forgive my shortcomings and my sins.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that a servant covered with shame be made hopeful and enabled to perform good acts; links pardon to a changed life.

selected.text: O Lord! Forgive and bestow Thy favors upon Ahmad, the father of this servant of Thy threshold. Make him an intimate companion in the privacy of Thy forgiveness. Give him to drink from the heart-delighting stream of Thy pardon and immerse him in the ocean of Thy forgiveness.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that a father be made an intimate companion in the privacy of forgiveness; distinctive image.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thy Most Exalted Beauty to give to drink from the wine of Thy reunion to all who have forsaken Thee, and to cause all who have heard Thee to hearken to the verses of Thy Beauty. Disappoint not those who hope in Thee, and drive not away those who long for Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking that all who have forsaken God be given the wine of reunion; hope extended to the estranged.

selected.text: Lord! Forgive Me and him our shortcomings, draw him out of misfortunes, lift off his anguish and lead him to the fountainhead of Thy bounty and let him to drink from the chalice of faithfulness and make him a sign of Thy grace and loving-kindness in the midmost of paradise and through the heaven
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking forgiveness for himself and another and that the other be made a sign of grace; intercession alongside self-inclusion.

selected.text: My God, my God! Look not upon my self and my transgressions, but rather upon the Sun of Thy bounty and the Heaven of Thy generosity. I have come unto Thee detached from all else beside Thee. Do with me as beseemeth Thee. We testify that Thou art the Forgiving, the Merciful.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking God to look not on self and transgressions but on the Sun of bounty; turns attention from self to grace.

selected.text: I beseech Thee … to ordain for me that which Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones who have acknowledged that which Thy Prophets have uttered. O Lord! I am the poor one who hath turned unto the ocean of Thy wealth, and I am the sinner who hath sought the Kawthar of Thy forgiveness
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh describing the sinner who seeks the Kawthar of forgiveness; the water image.

selected.text: O my Lord! Thou seest me standing before the door of Thy grace, clinging to the hem of the robe of Thy loving-kindness. I beseech Thee by the Name through which the earth was overturned and its high places made low, to forgive me and whosoever hath acknowledged Thy unity and oneness.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking forgiveness for oneself and all who acknowledge divine unity; joins self and community.

selected.text: O Lord! I am the thirsty one, and with Thee is the Kawthar of life; I am the transgressor, and with Thee is the ocean of forgiveness. Deprive me not, O my God, from the ocean of Thy bounty, and make me not deprived of Thy grace, O Thou in Whose grasp is the kingdom of all possibilities.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh: I am the transgressor, and with Thee is the ocean of forgiveness; a vivid antithesis.

selected.text: O God, My God! This is one of Thy humble and lowly maidservants who hath fervently prayed to the kingdom of Thy unity. She hath implored Thee in the heart of dawn, and besought Thee in the dark of night and at the height of day, relying upon Thee and imploring Thy forgiveness and pardon.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a maidservant who implored forgiveness at dawn, night and midday; shows persistent prayer.

selected.text: We beseech God, exalted be He, to forgive you and ordain for you that which shall profit you in all His worlds. Verily He is potent over all things and worthy to answer. May He send down upon you His blessings and ordain for you attendance before His presence or the reward of meeting Him.
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh praying for forgiveness and attendance before God for the recipients; correspondence of hope.

selected.text: O Kind God! We are sinful and You are the Forgiver. We are wicked and You are the Pardoning, All-Forgiving One. … Though the waves of sin have risen high, yet we trust in Your pardon and forgiveness. Though the flood of disobedience has reached its peak, yet we cling to Your grace and bounty
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá trusting in pardon though the waves of sin have risen high; a vivid image of mercy exceeding sin.

selected.text: Have mercy, O Most Merciful One of the heavens and earth, and forgive, O All-Forgiving One, those who dwell in the kingdom of command and creation. O Lord! Thou seest the sinner seeking after the waves of the ocean of Thy forgiveness and the effulgences of the lights of the Sun of Thy pardon.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking forgiveness for all who dwell in the kingdom of command and creation; universality of pardon.

selected.text: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Forgive these souls, then forgive me and have mercy upon me, then pardon me for what I have committed before Thee, for this is a station Thou hast reserved for Thyself and made it a testimony of Thy Being and a guidance and a light and a mercy unto all the worlds.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking forgiveness first for these souls, then for oneself; prayer that puts others first.

selected.text: We beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to forgive thee and thy parents, and those who have turned to the Most Great Manifestation and believed in God, the One, the All-Informed. Verily, He forgiveth whom He willeth through His mercy, and chastiseth those who have denied the Day of Judgment.
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh praying forgiveness for the recipient and parents while affirming God forgives whom He wills; a necessary qualification.

selected.text: My God, my God! I am Your servant, despairing of myself, overwhelmed by my transgressions, my great sins, my severe disobedience, and my excessive rebellion. I have nothing except Your magnificent beneficence and all-encompassing forgiveness … Forgive my sins, pardon my errors and stumbles
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá despairing of self yet relying on all-encompassing forgiveness; holds despair of self apart from despair of God.

selected.text: My God, my God! Thou seest Thy servants and Thy creation, and Thou knowest them better than they know themselves. Transform their evil into good and their injustice into justice. Then, O my God, extinguish the fire of hatred and animosity with the Kawthar of Thy mercy and the water of Thy grace.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking God to transform evil into good and injustice into justice and to quench hatred with mercy; extends forgiveness to social healing.

selected.text: O Pure God! Look not upon her shortcomings, for Thou art the Lord of forgiveness. Deal not with her according to justice, for Thou art the Master of abundant grace. Though transgressions be endless, Thy pardon and forgiveness are greater still. Thou art the Merciful, the Bestower, the All-Loving.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá declaring that though transgressions be endless pardon is greater still; mercy beyond justice for the departed.

selected.text: Therefore, O my Beloved, forgive me and my transgressions which I have committed before Thee, for my very mention of Thee is a sin that nothing in earth or heaven can equal. Then forgive my parents, my loved ones, my kindred and my relatives, for verily Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful.
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh declaring that even mention of God is a sin and asking pardon for parents and kindred; anguish joined with prayer for others.

selected.text: O Kind One! O Radiant and Resplendent Bestower! … [Name] was wandering and bewildered in this world. Grant him order and arrangement in Thy world. He was without refuge or shelter - give him a dwelling and abode in the shelter of Thy Great Mercy … Thou art the Forgiver, the Illuminator, the Kind One
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for one wandering and bewildered in this world to be given order and shelter in the next; continuing growth.

selected.text: O Bestower of kindness! A handmaiden most humble and meek, powerless and helpless, lowly and suppliant, hath returned and sought refuge at the court of Thy grandeur. To grant forgiveness and pardon and to be clement beseemeth a master. Withhold not, therefore, O Lord, Thy mercy and Thy forgiveness.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá declaring that to grant pardon and be clement beseems a master; a memorable rationale.

selected.text: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having illumined me with the lights of the Orb of Thy bounty and for having sent down unto me that which hath drawn me nigh unto the shore of the ocean of Thy nearness. O Lord! Adorn my temple with the robe of righteousness and my head with the crown of detachment.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking to be adorned with the robe of righteousness and crown of detachment; the changed life pardon makes possible.

selected.text: Lord, Lord! We are sinners and Thou art the All-Forgiving, the All-Merciful. We are transgressors and Thou art the Pardoner, the All-Bountiful. Deal not with us according to what we deserve, but deal with us according to Thy forgiveness, Thy pardon and Thy grace, O All-Merciful, O All-Compassionate!
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking to be dealt with according to forgiveness rather than desert; states the contrast of justice and grace.

selected.text: Write down for me, O my God, the good of this world and the next. Then forgive me and my parents and those for whom Thou hast desired the wondrous tokens of Thy bounty and favor. Thou art He through Whose Name the ocean of forgiveness surged and the fragrance of Thy name, the All-Merciful, was wafted.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking forgiveness for self and parents through Him by whose Name the ocean of forgiveness surged; family prayer with image.

selected.text: Mirza Haydar-'Ali Usku'i, with utmost humility and need, offered prayers and supplications to the Kingdom of Mystery, and sought endless forgiveness for you - that is, a spring like that of Job: "This is a cool bath and drink" - so that you may be resurrected in perfect health, wellness and safety
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá describing another believer’s prayer for the recipient’s forgiveness, a spring like Job’s; intercession among believers.

selected.text: And I beseech Thee, at that hour, to forgive them that were heedless of Thy Most Great remembrance and turned unto the desires of vain fancy; yea, forgive them, for they are Thy servants and Thy bondsmen, possessing no power over their own benefit or harm, nor over life or resurrection
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking forgiveness for the heedless, for they are servants without power over their own harm; compassion for the misguided.

selected.text: O my Lord and my hope and ultimate desire! Verily Your servant Muhammad supplicates to Your kingdom and implores Your dominion and seeks Your pardon and forgiveness for his noble father and beloved brother … Forgive his father and brother their sins and errors, admit them to the garden of grace and bounty
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a son seeking pardon for father and brother; family intercession.

selected.text: Having acknowledged, O my God, with my soul, my tongue, mine essence, and with mine inner and outer being, all my trespasses, whose like mortal eyes have never beheld nor human minds conceived, I implore Thee to pardon me and Thy loved ones for whatsoever we have failed to observe of Thy laws and ordinances.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: And as for the request for forgiveness and pardon specifically for thyself and thy parents, this blessed word issued forth from the horizon of the Mouth of Will: "God hath answered what thou didst desire from the wonders of His grace and the ocean of His forgiveness. Verily, He is the Generous, the Bountiful."
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh answering a request for forgiveness for self and parents; answered prayer.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O my God, by the Mirrors reflecting Thy beauty and the Daysprings manifesting Thy majesty, that Thou forgive those who have migrated in Thy path and journeyed from their homes to the wellspring of union with Thee, and who have detached themselves from all else to reach the city of Thy presence
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking forgiveness for those who migrated and detached themselves to reach the city of presence; nearness through revelation.

selected.text: O Lord! Verily, Thy servant Muhammad-'Ali seeketh forgiveness for his father and sister, who responded to the call and turned unto Thee with hearts assured of Thy grace and bounty. … O Lord! Forgive them through Thy mercy which hath preceded all things, and cause them to enter the precincts of Thy supreme mercy
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a son seeking forgiveness for father and sister; family intercession.

selected.text: O my Lord! I am he who hath turned unto Thee and hath placed his trust in Thee. Ordain for me what shall profit me in Thy worlds. Verily Thou knowest what is within myself while I know not what is within Thyself. Thou art verily the Almighty, the Powerful. There is no God but Thee, the Forgiving, the Merciful.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh trusting God who knows what is within oneself; reliance beyond self-knowledge.

selected.text: I am a sinner, O my Lord, and Thou art the Ever-Forgiving. As soon as I recognized Thee, I hastened to attain the exalted court of Thy loving-kindness. Forgive me, O my Lord, my sins which have hindered me from walking in the ways of Thy good-pleasure, and from attaining the shores of the ocean of Thy oneness
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: My God, my God! Adorn the temples of the heedless with the light of acceptance, the deniers with the ornament of recognition, and the idolaters with the radiance of unity and oneness. O my Lord! Aid them to return to the gate of Thy forgiveness. Verily Thou art the Ever-Forgiving, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking that deniers and idolaters be aided to return to the gate of forgiveness; prayer for those outside.

selected.text: "Our Lord! Forgive me and those who have appeared before the Countenance and her and her sister's son." This ended. This is a great glad-tiding. God willing, may all attain the robe of forgiveness. We continually beseech this from God, exalted be His glory, and it will surely be adorned with the honor of acceptance.
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh recording a prayer and its glad-tidings of forgiveness; correspondence around pardon.

selected.text: O my God and my Lord! How can I seek Thy forgiveness for my grievous sins and my great transgressions, knowing that all this was naught but the warbling of the Dove of Thine eternity in my heart, the surging of the waves of Thy love in my breast, and the manifestation of the countenance of Thy identity in my heart?
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh asking how forgiveness can be sought when sin is but the warbling of the Dove in the heart; mystical self-effacement.

selected.text: O Lord! Forgive the one who has sought the vicinity of Your vast mercy, and pardon Your servant who has turned toward Your broad and distant threshold. Immerse him in the seas of Your forgiveness and pardon, and grant him the cup of Your grace and forgiveness. Verily You are the Pardoning, the Forgiving, the Merciful.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that one who sought mercy be immersed in seas of forgiveness; prayer for the departed.

selected.text: hath befallen the Choice Wine through the tyranny of the aggressors and the calumnies of the slanderers. By the life of our Lord and the Lord of the Throne and earth! They have exchanged truth for falsehood, trustworthiness for treachery, acceptance for rejection, justice for tyranny, and fairness for oppression. Through this every fair-minded one hath lamented, the sighs of every assured one have ascended, and the tears of every seeing one have fallen. I beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to assist them to return unto Him, to turn in repentance at the door of His bounty, and to stand before
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh lamenting the tyranny and calumnies of aggressors yet beseeching that they return in repentance; names the harm while hoping for return.

selected.text: O my Lord! I am Thy handmaiden and the daughter of Thy handmaiden, clinging to the cord of Thy bounty and holding fast to the hem of Thy mercy … to purify me and Thy other handmaiden, through the Kawthar of Thy utterance and the Salsabil of Thy bounty, from every sin and error which Thou hast inscribed by Thy knowledge
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh voiced by a handmaiden asking purification for herself and another handmaiden; a woman’s prayer for pardon.

selected.text: Then I beseech Thee, O my God and my Beloved, by Thy Most Beautiful Names and Thy most exalted attributes, and by the Manifestation of Thy Most Great Name, and by Thy resplendent beauty in the heaven of eternity, that Thou forgive me and my parents and my brothers and my kindred, and that Thou absolve them of their misdeeds
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking forgiveness for self, parents, brothers and kindred; broadens family circle.

selected.text: O Lord! Forgive me and those with me, those who have held fast to Thy firm handles and clung to the hem of Thy luminous robe. Then draw the hearts of Thy creation to the horizon of the heaven of Thy manifestation. Verily, Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Ever-Flowing, the Most Generous, the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking forgiveness for self and companions and that hearts be drawn to the horizon of manifestation; companionship in prayer.

selected.text: O Kind Lord! Sin is as the darkness of night, while Thy pardon and forgiveness are as rays of light. In the presence of brilliant light, what effect can the darkness of the earthly realm have? And in the presence of the sun, what power can shadows possess? … Thou art the All-Forgiving, the Bestower, the Kind, the Resplendent
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá likening sin to night and pardon to rays of light that darkness cannot withstand; a foundational image of mercy’s sufficiency.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the wonders of Thy verses, and the standards of Thy clear proofs, and that which the tongue of Thy grandeur hath spoken, to aid those who have turned away to turn towards Thee, the calumniators to be truthful, the deniers to acknowledge, and the irreligious to return to the gate of Thy pardon and forgiveness
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking that calumniators become truthful and the irreligious return to the gate of pardon; truthfulness as the fruit of return.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou art the Generous One, Thou art the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful. Do not hold us to account for grievous sin, but treat us according to Thy mighty grace. Forgive these souls who have appeared at Thy spacious gate, who have placed their trust in Thee and turned to Thee, yearning for grace and forgiveness before Thee.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking forgiveness for souls who have appeared at the spacious gate; communal petition.

selected.text: Though we are sinners and evildoers, drowned in rebellion and fallen into oppression and transgression, yet we are helpless and wandering, with hearts torn into a hundred pieces. We offer prayers and present our needs, seeking pardon and forgiveness, grace and mercy. We are worthy of forgiveness and deserving of favor and pardon.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for helpless and wandering hearts seeking pardon; honest confession within the family section.

selected.text: I ask forgiveness of Thee by Thy names and attributes. Deal not with me according to my deserts, for verily Thou art the God of virtue and the Lord of forgiveness. Verily I seek Thy pardon and repent before Thee of all that was ascribed to me instead of that which was worthy of Thee, for Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful
selected.reason: Prayer of the Báb asking not to be dealt with according to deserts and repenting before God; adds the Báb’s voice to the confession.

selected.text: O my God! This is a maidservant who hath turned toward the horizon of Thy mercy, seeking Thy pardon and forgiveness, imploring Thy clemency and remission for her mother who hath returned unto Thee and come into Thy presence. O Lord! Purify her from her sins and forgive her through Thy mercy, O Thou Most Merciful of the merciful ones!
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a maidservant seeking forgiveness for her mother who has returned to God; prayer for a departed parent.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Ancient Lord, by the Most Great Name through which Thou didst subdue the world and didst open before their faces the gates of bounty, grace and generosity, that Thou mayest acquaint Thy servants with that which they have neglected, then draw them near, O my God, to the ocean of Thy bestowal [and heaven of] Thy gifts.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking that servants be acquainted with what they have neglected and drawn near; awareness as a gift of grace.

selected.text: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by those who were martyred in Thy path and soared in the atmosphere of Thy love in such wise that the power of the world could not hold them back from the Most Great Name, that Thou forgive me and my father and my mother and whosoever hath held fast unto Thy Strong Cord, O God of the worlds!
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh invoking those martyred in His path and asking forgiveness for self and parents; martyrs as intercessors.

selected.text: Verily, I have been among the wrongdoers, and I call upon Thee in the darkness of remoteness that there is no God but Thee. Glory be unto Thee! Verily, I am of those who repent. Answer Thou my prayer and have mercy upon me, for Thou art the Beloved of them that know Thee, and praise be unto Thee, for Thou art God, the Lord of all worlds.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh declaring oneself among the wrongdoers and among those who repent, calling from the darkness of remoteness; a classic act of repentance.

selected.text: I seek Thy forgiveness for what I have said and say. And I say thereafter and beseech Thee to transform all that Thy knowledge encompasseth of me into that which befitteth Thy Self and that which characterized Thy station of majesty and glory, grandeur and beauty, might and grace, power and beneficence, through Thy favor and Thy generosity
selected.reason: Passage of the Báb seeking forgiveness for what has been said and asking that all known of him be transformed; transformation through grace.

selected.text: Glorified art Thou, O my God, my Lord and my Support! I beseech Thee by Thy Name, the All-Bountiful, and glorified art Thou, O my God, I beseech Thee by Thy Name, the All-Forgiving, and glorified art Thou, O my God, I beseech Thee by Thy Name, the Concealer, to conceal the sins of Thy servants and whatsoever they have committed in Thy days.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh invoking the All-Bountiful, the All-Forgiving and the Concealer to conceal sins; litany of divine names.

selected.text: O Forgiver, we are all sinners and wrongdoers. Thou art the Forgiver, Thou art the Bestower, the Kind. Look not upon our worth and merit, but look upon Thy grace and pardon. Immerse us in the ocean of forgiveness and make us companions of the Supreme Concourse in the Most Glorious Paradise. Thou art the Merciful, Thou art the All-Compassionate.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that sinners be immersed in forgiveness and made companions of the Supreme Concourse; joins pardon to spiritual companionship.

selected.text: O Lord! I beseech Thee by the waves of the ocean of Thy mercy and the effulgences of the lights of the sun of Thy grace, to aid Thy heedless servants to return to the court of Thy glory and to enter the precincts of Thy grandeur. O Lord! Disappoint them not through Thy bounty and generosity, and deprive them not from the heaven of Thy bestowals.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking that heedless servants be aided to return to the court of glory; prayer for others’ return.

selected.text: O Lord! O Forgiver! Though we are sinners and tread the path of rebellion, yet we knock at the door of forgiveness and seek Thy good-pleasure, speak Thy mysteries, and implore pardon and forgiveness. We seek Thy boundless favors and ask for Thy blessing and forgiveness. Look not upon our shortcomings and perceive not our weakness and lassitude.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá knocking at the door of forgiveness despite rebellion; an image of persistent return.

selected.text: O Pure Lord! We are all sinners, and Thou art the Forgiver. We are all filled with faults, and Thou art the Remover of difficulties. Record not the sins of these wrongdoers in the Preserved Tablet, and erase them from the outstretched parchment. Look not upon our worthiness and capacity - deal with us in a manner befitting Thy merciful threshold.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that sins be erased from the Preserved Tablet and that God deal as befits His threshold; a distinctive image of erasure.

selected.text: O peerless Lord! This destitute one has fallen at Thy threshold, bewildered and distracted, enamored and devoted, seeking forgiveness for a loving mother. Thou art the one true Bestower and the Giver to all, whether friend or stranger. Grant forgiveness that it may cause the rain of mercy to descend and nourish the soul of that honored handmaiden.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá seeking forgiveness for a loving mother so that mercy may nourish her soul; an early example of intercession for a parent.

selected.text: O Lord! His brother Yahya hath called upon Thy servants who circle round the throne of Thy mercy to seek forgiveness for that one who hath ascended to the highest horizon of reunion. Therefore all are calling upon Thee with tongues of supplication and lowliness, and seeking forgiveness for him. Verily, Thou art the Ever-Forgiving, the All-Merciful.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá in which many join a brother in seeking forgiveness for one who ascended; communal intercession.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O my God, by Thy Manifestation through Whom the Hour was thrown into commotion and the Resurrection took flight, and every intimate friend and confidant fell away, and through Whom darkness was illumined and the Word shone forth and the proof was perfected, to clothe her with the robe of forgiveness and purify her from transgression.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking that a departed woman be clothed with the robe of forgiveness; the robe image.

selected.text: O Compassionate Lord! These three souls are deserving of pardon and forgiveness, and worthy of Thy grace and bounty. O Thou Shelter of the helpless! Forgive the sins of the sinners and teach wisdom to the ignorant. Set the ocean of forgiveness in motion, that every soul stained with sin may become tranquil and pure, and all faces may become radiant.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking the ocean of forgiveness to be set in motion so every stained soul becomes pure; the cleansing image.

selected.text: O Lord! O Forgiver of sins and Accepter of repentance! O Most Merciful in this world and the next! Verily the servant has no Lord but You, and the sinner has no forgiver besides You … Treat us with Your grace, Your pardon and Your forgiveness, and do not hold us accountable for our negligence in Your path. Verily You are the Pardoning, the Forgiving
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to the Forgiver of sins and Accepter of repentance, for the sinner has no forgiver besides God; a foundational statement.

selected.text: O my Forgiver, O my Pardoner! I press my face and soil my brow in the dust at the threshold of Thy sacred court, beseeching the outpouring of Thy pardon, Thy favor, Thy generosity and Thy grace for Thy servant who has turned to Thee and entered the precincts of Thy forgiveness and pardon. … My God, my God! Pardon him and forgive him for the sake of his son
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking pardon for a father for the sake of his son; the merit of a child as intercession.

selected.text: O God, our Lord! Leave us not to ourselves, but preserve us through Thy power that encompasseth all things, and guard us from every slip and sin. Guide us along the shining white path and the radiant straight way, for we are sinners and Thou art the All-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful; we are transgressors and Thou art the All-Merciful, the Most Compassionate.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking not to be left to ourselves but guarded from every slip and guided on the straight way; preventive grace.

selected.text: O God, O Forgiver of sins and Concealer of faults, O Remover of sorrows! Assist Your servant who has turned to You, through Your mercy which has preceded all things and Your grace which has been bestowed throughout the world of creation. Immerse him, O my God, in the oceans of Your pardon and purify him from every sin, and grant him an exalted seat of truth.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to the Forgiver of sins and Concealer of faults asking that a servant be immersed in oceans of pardon; a complete petition.

selected.text: The handmaiden of Thy threshold, Malaki, has hastened to the realm of purity. Therefore, make her soul radiant and immerse her in the ocean of forgiveness, and grant her a portion from Thy grace and favor. Forgive her and bestow Thy kindness upon her, and make her the intimate companion of the angels in the realm of mystery. Thou art the Bestower, the Giver, the Forgiver, and the Kind One
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for Malaki to be made an intimate companion of the angels; companionship in the next world.

selected.text: O my God, my Adored One, my Beloved, my Heart's Desire! With what countenance shall I turn to Thy most glorious Kingdom, and with what tongue shall I implore Thy forgiveness and pardon? Not once did I draw a breath purely for Thy sake, freed from this cage of self, nor did I take a single step save in pursuit of my own desires. O my God, so immersed am I in transgression that I am ashamed of the very act of transgression itself, let alone standing before Thy most holy presence
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh confessing that not one breath was drawn purely for God and expressing shame at transgression itself; a searching act of self-examination.

selected.text: O my God, my God! Thou didst desire for Thy servants that which would exalt them in Thy lands, yet they have wrought that which hath rent asunder the veil of Thy sanctity. I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance and the effulgences of the Orb of Thy Revelation to aid them to return unto Thee. Verily Thou art the Mighty, the Powerful, the All-Bountiful.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh lamenting that servants have rent the veil of sanctity and asking that they return; wrongdoing named alongside hope.

selected.text: Alas for me and for those who are like me and who walk in my path! It is as though I disobeyed Thee with every disobedience, O Thou in Whose hand is the dominion of forgiveness and pardon … Then, O my God, did I return from all this unto Thee, disappointed, in loss, remorseful and abased, and I beseech Thee … that Thou show mercy unto me and forgive me and pardon me
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh returning to God disappointed, remorseful and abased after every disobedience; shows confession as a return.

selected.text: And as for his supplication to God, exalted be His glory, seeking forgiveness for his parents, this was presented, and the Tongue of Grandeur spoke these words: "Upon them be the Glory of God. God hath forgiven them both as a favor from His presence unto thee, O 'Ali. This is naught but a great bounty. Be thou grateful and say: Praise be unto Thee, O God of the worlds."
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh quoting the Tongue of Grandeur: God hath forgiven them both, and calling for gratitude; answered prayer and thanks.

selected.text: I beseech boundless bounties for thee and for thy father Khudarahm, and I seek the favors of the All-Merciful Lord. For Gulbanu Ardishir I seek sweet milk from the breast of forgiveness, and for the fortune of Ardishir I desire a portion and share from the bounty and pardon of the Lord of creation. And for Shahryar Khudabakhsh I seek boundless bounty and infinite favors.
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá seeking sweet milk from the breast of forgiveness for named family members; a memorable maternal image.

selected.text: My God, my God, my Lord and my Hope! I beseech the Kingdom of Thy mercy, I humble myself before the Dominion of Thy oneness, I take refuge at the gate of Thy unity, and I seek abundance from the cloud of Thy mercy. … I implore Thee to encompass these servants with the glances of the eye of Thy mercy and Thy favors, to immerse them in the ocean of Thy pardon and forgiveness
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that these servants be immersed in the ocean of pardon; prayer for a group.

selected.text: O Pure Lord! Forgive the sins of Khudadad's father and mother and make those two souls pure and radiant. Free them from defilement and favor them with detachment. Grant them entry to the feast of meeting and make them joyful at the heavenly celebration. Deliver them from the furnace and bring them into the rose garden. Grant them release from death and bestow eternal life.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that parents be freed from defilement, brought from furnace to rose garden; a vivid image.

selected.text: O my God! O my God! These are maidservants who have arisen in faithfulness at Thy holy threshold, O Lord of the Most Beautiful Names, and have hastened to the wellspring of Thy mercy in the world of eternity. O Lord! Immerse them in the seas of Thy great mercy, and shelter them at Thy luminous holy threshold, and forgive them through Thy mercy which has encompassed all things
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for maidservants who arose in faithfulness, asking they be sheltered and forgiven; faithfulness remembered.

selected.text: O God, O Gracious One, O Merciful One! I have turned to Thee, and am clinging to the cord of Thy bounty, and am holding fast to the hem of Thy generosity. Thou art the Gracious One - a single drop from the ocean of Thy forgiveness would wash away the transgressions of all mankind, and one word from the mouth of Thy grace would bestow the water of life upon all contingent beings.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh: a single drop from the ocean of forgiveness would wash away the transgressions of all mankind; a foundational image.

selected.text: Aid me and aid Thy sincere servants through Thy great favor in all regions, grant bounty and pardon wrongdoing, remove the veil from the eyes of the people of passion, guide to the right path all who have gone astray and erred, take not to task those among Thy wretched servants who have transgressed and rebelled, but treat them with grace and beneficence and forgiveness of sins.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that those who transgressed and rebelled be treated with grace and forgiveness; mercy for opponents.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the sovereignty of Thy forgiveness, which hath encompassed the people of rebellion, that Thou forgive the father of Thy servant who communed with Thee in the hidden recesses of his heart and openly. … Do Thou forgive his father who hath passed away. … O my Lord! Immerse him in the ocean of Thy great mercy and lead him to the fountains of Thy pardon, O Forgiver of sins
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá invoking the sovereignty of forgiveness for a servant’s departed father; extended intercession.

selected.text: My God, my God! I testify to the sanctity of Thy Being above mention and utterance, and the exaltation of Thy Self above what is ordained in contingent existence … O Lord! The thirst of separation from Thee hath consumed me - where is the sweet water of Thy mercy? My transgressions have removed me far from the court of Thy nearness - where are the waves of the ocean of Thy forgiveness
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking where the sweet water of mercy and the waves of forgiveness are for one far from nearness; images of thirst and separation.

selected.text: O Lord, O Forgiver, these are broken-winged birds - bestow upon them wings and feathers and enable them to soar in the heights of pardon and forgiveness. Grant these helpless ones shelter and refuge in the protection of Thy forgiveness. Lead these thirsty ones to the spring of favors and seat these needy ones at Thy bountiful table. Deliver them from the dark and gloomy night of deprivation and separation, and brighten their
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for broken-winged birds to be given wings to soar in the heights of pardon; a memorable image of restoration.

selected.text: My God, my God! Thy separation hath brought me to nothingness and my deeds have kept me far from Thee in Thy days. I beseech Thee by Thy Cause through which the fragrance of Thy mercy was wafted throughout creation, and by Thy loving-kindness whereby the ocean of forgiveness surged before the faces of all peoples, that Thou forgive me and those who have believed in Thee and in Thy verses
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh describing separation that brings one to nothingness and asking forgiveness for self and believers; vivid communal prayer.

selected.text: O Lord! Forgive the transgressions of these souls and conceal the misdeeds of these lowly ones. Thou art aware, Thou art knowing, Thou art informed, Thou art cognizant. We are sinners, we are transgressors, we are heedless, we are negligent. Thou art the Pardoner, Thou art the Forgiving, Thou art the Gracious, Thou art the Merciful. Verily Thou art the Ever-Forgiving, the Concealer of faults.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for the transgressions of these souls, naming God the Concealer of faults; a communal prayer of concealment.

selected.text: No deed have I done, O my God, to merit beholding Thy face, and I know of a certainty that were I to live as long as the world lasts I would fail to accomplish any deed such as to deserve this favor, inasmuch as the station of a servant shall ever fall short of access to Thy holy precincts, unless Thy bounty should reach me and Thy tender mercy pervade me and Thy loving-kindness encompass
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O Lord! Make Your servant Elijah distinguished and successful in the eternal world. Grant pardon and forgiveness. Bestow Your ancient forgiveness, for the noble son is the intercessor for that sinful father. This son made up for that father - though that one was unaware, this one became a fruitful tree and is worthy of endless favors and kindnesses. You are the Giver, the Bestower, the Forgiver, the Kind.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá declaring that a noble son is the intercessor for a sinful father; a key statement of intercession.

selected.text: 'Abdu'l-Baha likewise entreats the Threshold of Oneness with utmost fervor, weeping and hoping that perchance the musk-laden breeze of the Lord's forgiveness may reach the nostrils of the soul, and a wave from the ocean of divine pardon may wash over him, delivering him from the defilement of sins and transgressions. This is not far from the ocean of Baha's grace, His mercy, His pardon and His forgiveness.
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá weeping in hope that a wave of pardon wash over him; humility of the intercessor.

selected.text: My God, my God! Verily Your maidservant who has attained salvation, Ziya'u'l-Hajiyyih, implores You begging forgiveness and pardon for her father, and supplicates You to make her father a sign of forgiveness shining in the horizon of pardon and beneficence. O Lord! Answer her prayer, facilitate her hopes, and grant her desire. Verily You are the Generous and verily You are the All-Merciful, the Compassionate.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a daughter seeking pardon for her father; intercession by name.

selected.text: O Lord of Grace and Forgiveness! Grant endless bounty to the servant of the Threshold Fadlu'llah and forgive his sins. Give Fatimah Begum an abundant portion and make her forgiven and pardoned. Make Zaynu'l-'Abidin one of those drawn nigh and raise him to the highest heaven. Make 'Inayatu'llah a manifestation of Thy greatest mercy and grant him mighty forgiveness. Thou art the Forgiver, the Giver, and the Kind One.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá naming several family members and asking forgiveness for each; a family remembered by name.

selected.text: Lauded be Thy name, O Lord of Being and Possessor of all things visible and invisible! I beseech Thee by the showers of Thy mercy, through which Thy bounties and favours were manifested unto Thy servants, and by the mysteries of Thy knowledge and the pearls of the ocean of Thy wisdom, to forgive me, and my parents, and every servant who hath clung firmly to this exalted station and hastened to this sublime habitation.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: this faithful and assured handmaiden dear at Thy Threshold, and guide this poor, bewildered one unto the treasure of the riches of Thy pardon. Lead this wanderer in the wilderness of longing unto the pavilion of nearness, and direct this thirsting one, whose liver is aflame in the desert of remoteness, unto the ocean of proximity and reunion. Immerse this assured leaf in this "cool and refreshing bath and drink," that she may be cleansed and sanctified from all the ills and ailments of the world of being, enter the Kingdom of Thy glory, and repose beneath the shade of the Tree
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a departed leaf to be immersed in a cool and refreshing bath; opens the section on the next world.

selected.text: My God, my God! Thou seest those who turned away from Thee and objected to Thee without any proof from Thee or evidence from Thy presence. I beseech Thee by the waves of the ocean of Thy utterance and by the splendors of the Day-Star of Thy grace and bounty to aid Thy servants to return unto Thee and to repent at the door of Thy generosity. Verily, Thou art powerful over what Thou willest through Thy word "Be" and it is
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for those who objected without proof, asking that they repent at the door of generosity; prayer for objectors.

selected.text: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! By Thy might! My transgressions have prevented me from turning toward the horizon of the heaven of Thy grace, and my sins from attaining presence before Thy face. Whenever I contemplate the ocean of Thy generosity and the sun of Thy bounty, joy overtaketh me from every direction, yet whenever I reflect upon my errors and transgressions, I long to hide my face beneath the layers of the earth.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh describing joy at the ocean of generosity and the wish to hide one’s face when reflecting on errors; holds remorse and hope together.

selected.text: O my God, my Beloved, my Helper and my Sustainer! How many days have I heard Thy mention and Thy call, yet failed to act in a manner befitting Thy days. Whenever I reflect upon myself, my grief and regret and sighs and shame increase. … I beseech Thee, O Thou through Whose Name the ocean of forgiveness surged and the fragrance of the garment of Thy Name, the All-Merciful, was diffused, to assist me in serving Thee and remembering Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh regretting failure to act befittingly and asking for help in service and remembrance; pardon leading to service.

selected.text: We beseech God to open our eyes and make us aware of ourselves and our deeds. If we are not enabled to know His exalted Self, may we at least be enabled to know our heedless selves, and may He remove from our faces the veils that prevent us from beholding Him rising from the horizon of grace and bounty, that we may detach ourselves from all who dwell in the realms of creation and turn wholly toward Him, for He is our All-Merciful Lord.
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh asking God to make us aware of ourselves and our deeds; grounds forgiveness in honest self-knowledge.

selected.text: O Ocean of pardon and forgiveness, O Sun of forbearance and grace and benevolence! Assist Thy supplicating servant, purify him from sin, save him from deprivation, raise him from the abyss of separation, admit him into the garden of the All-Merciful, shelter him in Thy proximity O Bestower, shade him beneath the tree of Thy mercy O Helper, grant him the joy of meeting Thee, perfect Thy mercy upon him, and shower Thy blessings upon him.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to the Ocean of pardon asking that a servant be raised from the abyss of separation and sheltered; a full sequence of images.

selected.text: O my Lord! I am he who transgressed against Thee and opposed Thy beauty, being occupied with my self and my desires, and verily Thou art the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. O my Lord! When I recognized Thy Self, I sought Thy forgiveness for what I had been and for what appeared from my tongue and issued from my mouth and occurred to my heart, and I have turned unto Thee with my whole being, for verily Thou art the All-Forgiving, the All-Merciful.
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh voicing one who opposed God’s beauty and, on recognition, sought forgiveness for word, deed and thought; a narrative of return.

selected.text: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I am he who was neglectful in Thy path and followed the ways of fancy and imagination, being veiled from the recognition of the Manifestation of Thy Self, and I argued with that which burned the liver of Ali and then the heart of Muhammad, the Messenger of God, as though I had slain all existence, both seen and unseen. Therefore, O my God, look upon me with the glances of Thy mercy and leave me not to myself and my desires.
selected.reason: Passage from the Kitáb-i-Badí‘ voicing one who argued against the Manifestation and now asks not to be left to his desires; concrete wrongdoing confessed.

selected.text: My God, my God! Thou seest me casting my face in the dust of lowliness before Thy mighty Oneness, and seeking forgiveness for Thy servant who hath forsaken all contingent things and soared on wings of longing to the unseen realm of the worlds. … O Lord! He hath come before Thee and approached Thy threshold, seeking Thy pardon and hoping for Thy grace, awaiting the manifestations of Thy tender mercy. Do Thou forgive him and his companion who hath returned unto Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá seeking forgiveness for one who soared to the unseen realm and his companion; prayer for the departed and companions.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O God of the world and Desire of the nations, to aid him and those who turned away to return unto Thee and to repent at the door of Thy mercy. Thou knowest that I summoned him in all conditions unto Thee until he drew against Me the sword of hatred and there appeared from him that which caused the limbs of all things to quake. O Lord! Help him to return to the door of Thy mercy, which Thou hast opened through Thy Most Great Name unto all peoples.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for one who drew the sword of hatred, asking that he return to the door of mercy; prayer for an opponent.

selected.text: O Forgiving Lord! Forgive the sins of Thy faithful servant Khudarahm, conceal his errors, bestow Thy gifts, cleanse him from the defilement of disobedience, and admit him into the luminous realm. O Lord! Though we are sinners and confess our sins, we are worthy of the forgiveness of the Lord. O Forgiving One! Thou art the Bestower and the Kind, the Brilliant and the Radiant One. Make worthy Thy freely-given grace and bounty. Thou art the Forgiver, the Merciful One.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá confessing our sins while asking forgiveness for a faithful servant; humility in intercession.

selected.text: In the Name of our Lord, the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing! … My God, my God! Thou seest mine eyes fixed upon the horizon of Thy grace and the hands of this poor one raised to the heaven of Thy bounty. Whenever I contemplate Thy justice, O my God, my limbs tremble, my heart is agitated, my joints quiver, my sighs ascend and my tears fall. Yet whenever I contemplate Thy grace and Thy dealings with Thy loved ones, my spirit soars, my heart is assured and my soul finds rest
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh contrasting trembling before divine justice with the assurance found in contemplating grace; opens the guide’s tension between fear and hope.

selected.text: O my God, if Thou shouldst withhold from me the Euphrates of Thy forgiveness and the ocean of Thy mercy, who would show mercy to me and forgive me? Alas! Alas! I have abandoned what Thou didst command me and committed what Thou didst forbid me. By Thy might! Despite my acknowledgment of my grievous sins and great transgressions, I testify that they all are as nothing before the waves of the ocean of Thy mercy and the heaven of Thy pardon and the sun of Thy generosity.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh testifying that grievous sins are as nothing before the ocean of mercy; a key statement of mercy beyond measure.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou seest them cast upon the earth of heedlessness and forgetfulness, their deeds having prevented them from soaring in the atmosphere of Thy love, from turning to Thy face, and from entering the paradise of Thy presence. I beseech Thee, O Desired One of the world and Lord of the nations, by Thy mercy which Thou hast made the supreme cause for the tranquility and joy of Thy chosen ones, by Thy bounty and grace and favors, to deliver them from the darkness of self and passion.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for those cast down by heedlessness, asking that they be delivered from the darkness of self and passion; deliverance from self.

selected.text: After the performance of many ceremonials the Mullah in his most solemn voice asked the patient to repeat the formula "Oh God! I have sinned much. Confer upon me thy forgiveness … O Lord! O Lord! I am a real sinner and thou art the just God! I beg Thy Mercy! I have committed many sins. I have not done that which Thou hast commanded me and have practiced those things thou hast made unlawful. With humility and contrition I am standing in thy presence. Do with me whatever thou willest
selected.reason: Reported account of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá setting a Mullah’s repeated formula beside a sincere prayer of confession; carries the introduction’s story about prayer.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the finger of Thy power and will whereby the spheres of utterance revolved amidst the Concourse of creation, and by the pearls of the ocean of Thy knowledge and the manifestations of Thy grandeur in the kingdom of creation, and by this grave which Thou hast made the point of circumambulation for Thy servants and creatures, that Thou forgive me and my father and my mother and whosoever hath hastened to the gate of Thy grandeur and before the throne of Thy manifestation.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh at a grave asking forgiveness for self, father and mother; ties pardon to a place of visitation.

selected.text: O wise Nush! Since your good-natured father is kind to you and well-behaved and beneficent toward your brothers, therefore this sinful servant makes supplication for pardon and forgiveness from the Lord, that He may cleanse and purify him from the earthly world and grant him passage to the celestial realm. This intercession with utmost entreaty was solely for the sake of you and your brothers, that Gushtasb may become pure in soul and that forgiveness and pardon may encompass that servant of God
selected.reason: Passage of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá interceding for a father because of his kindness to his sons; intercession grounded in conduct.

selected.text: We beseech Him, exalted be He, by the ocean of His forgiveness, the heaven of His grace, and the sun of His mercy which hath preceded all created things, to send down upon him a heavenly feast and a blessing from His presence, and to cause him to enter the Most Exalted Paradise. Verily, He is the Bestower, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful. We have purified him at the time of his ascension from the world's defilement and forgiven him through Our grace, for We are the Mighty, the All-Forgiving.
selected.reason: Passage of Bahá’u’lláh announcing that a soul has been purified at his ascension and forgiven; a direct assurance of pardon.

selected.text: O Lord! This is Thy handmaiden who hath believed in the revelation of Thy Kingdom and taken refuge in the shelter of Thy forgiveness and supplicated unto the heaven of Thy pardon and turned toward the direction of Thy mercy.
